One actual post-A continuation, owned and joined by historical delivery.
//! Decision is observed from its checkpointed successor slot. Every later
//! publication and C receipt comes from the original concrete owner path.

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;
use std::time::Instant;

use codex_hepta_contracts::AuthorityClock;
use codex_hepta_contracts::FinalUseAuthority;
use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;

use super::OriginalFiles;
use super::artifacts::OriginalArtifactPlan;
use super::artifacts::OriginalSelectedArtifacts;
use super::c_task::OriginalCTaskPlan;
use super::c_task::OriginalExistingCTask;
use super::c_task::OriginalNewCTask;
use super::generation::OriginalGenerationFiles;
use super::material::OriginalMaterialWriter;
use super::post_a_remaining;
use super::refused;
use crate::AgentdError;
use crate::AgentdIdentity;
use crate::AgentdState;
use crate::AgentdUnixFinalUseGrantProvider;
use crate::LoadedCellQ24ModelV1;
use crate::OriginalCellQ24LearningStageOwnersV1;
use crate::OriginalQ24SuccessorHandoffV1;
use crate::cell_q24_publication_driver::require_successor_admission;
use crate::cell_q24_publication_driver::validation::Decision;
use crate::learning_iteration::historical_source::RegisteredHistoricalLearningSourceV1;
use crate::root_generation_publication_inputs::OriginalPreparedPublicationRoute;
use crate::root_historical_task_read_client::OriginalHistoricalLearningTrustV1;
use crate::root_historical_task_read_client::OriginalHistoricalTaskReadReceiptV1;

pub(super) struct OriginalContinuationInputs {
    pub source: Arc<RegisteredHistoricalLearningSourceV1>,
    pub owners: Arc<OriginalCellQ24LearningStageOwnersV1>,
    pub trust: Arc<OriginalHistoricalLearningTrustV1>,
    pub receipt: Arc<OriginalHistoricalTaskReadReceiptV1>,
    pub successor: OriginalQ24SuccessorHandoffV1,
    pub publication: OriginalPreparedPublicationRoute,
    pub material: OriginalMaterialWriter,
    pub artifacts: OriginalArtifactPlan,
    pub task: OriginalCTaskPlan,
    pub generation: OriginalGenerationFiles,
    pub files: OriginalFiles,
    pub baseline: Arc<LoadedCellQ24ModelV1>,
    pub final_use: Arc<FinalUseAuthority>,
    pub grants: Arc<AgentdUnixFinalUseGrantProvider>,
    pub clock: Arc<dyn AuthorityClock>,
    pub identity: AgentdIdentity,
    pub end: Instant,
}

pub(crate) struct OriginalPostAContinuationV1 {
    original: OriginalContinuationInputs,
}

enum PreparedCTask {
    New(OriginalNewCTask),
    Existing(OriginalExistingCTask),
}

impl PreparedCTask {
    fn target_data(&self) -> &codex_hepta_neuron::CellGenerationObserverConfigV1 {
        match self {
            Self::New(original) => &original.target_data,
            Self::Existing(original) => &original.target_data,
        }
    }

    fn require_original_custody(&self) -> Result<(), AgentdError> {
        match self {
            Self::New(original) => original.custody.require_original(),
            Self::Existing(original) => original.require_original_custody(),
        }
    }
}

impl OriginalPostAContinuationV1 {
    pub(super) fn from_original_inputs(
        original: OriginalContinuationInputs,
    ) -> Result<Self, AgentdError> {
        post_a_remaining(original.end)?;
        OriginalHistoricalLearningTrustV1::require_original_receipt(
            &original.trust,
            &original.receipt,
        )?;
        OriginalPreparedPublicationRoute::require_current(&original.publication)?;
        let recovering =
            OriginalCTaskPlan::require_original_mode(&original.task, &original.publication)?;
        OriginalGenerationFiles::require_original_lifecycle(&original.generation, recovering)?;
        Ok(Self { original })
    }

    pub(crate) fn require_original_delivery(
        &self,
        source: &Arc<RegisteredHistoricalLearningSourceV1>,
        owners: &Arc<OriginalCellQ24LearningStageOwnersV1>,
        identity: &AgentdIdentity,
    ) -> Result<(), AgentdError> {
        if !Arc::ptr_eq(source, &self.original.source)
            || !Arc::ptr_eq(owners, &self.original.owners)
            || identity != &self.original.identity
        {
            return Err(refused(
                "continuation belongs to another actual delivery or aggregate",
            ));
        }
        OriginalHistoricalLearningTrustV1::require_original_receipt(
            &self.original.trust,
            &self.original.receipt,
        )?;
        OriginalPreparedPublicationRoute::require_current(&self.original.publication)?;
        post_a_remaining(self.original.end)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) async fn run(
        self,
        state: Arc<AgentdState>,
        cancelled: CancellationToken,
    ) -> Result<(), AgentdError> {
        let OriginalContinuationInputs {
            source,
            owners,
            trust,
            receipt,
            successor,
            publication,
            material,
            artifacts,
            task,
            generation,
            mut files,
            baseline,
            final_use,
            grants,
            clock,
            identity,
            end,
        } = self.original;
        // C uses its actual prepared publication lane; this shared generic
        // provider remains part of the original launcher input only.
        drop(grants);
        loop {
            if cancelled.is_cancelled() {
                return Ok(());
            }
            post_a_remaining(end)?;
            if require_successor_admission(&state, &identity).is_ok() {
                break;
            }
            tokio::select! {
                _ = cancelled.cancelled() => return Ok(()),
                _ = tokio::time::sleep(post_a_remaining(end)?.min(Duration::from_millis(25))) => {}
            }
        }
        RegisteredHistoricalLearningSourceV1::require_current_historical_source(
            &source, &identity,
        )?;
        OriginalHistoricalLearningTrustV1::require_original_receipt(&trust, &receipt)?;
        let snapshot = tokio::select! {
            _ = cancelled.cancelled() => return Ok(()),
            result = tokio::time::timeout_at(end.into(), successor.decision_snapshot()) => {
                result.map_err(|_| refused("original Decision handoff deadline"))?.map_err(refused)?
            }
        };
        require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
        let decision = Decision::new(snapshot.clone()).map_err(refused)?;
        let OriginalSelectedArtifacts {
            selected,
            signed,
            custody: artifact_custody,
        } = OriginalArtifactPlan::publish_and_select_original(
            artifacts,
            &publication,
            Arc::clone(&owners),
            snapshot.clone(),
            final_use,
            clock,
            &mut files,
            &cancelled,
        )
        .await?;
        require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
        let recovering = OriginalCTaskPlan::require_original_mode(&task, &publication)?;
        OriginalGenerationFiles::require_original_lifecycle(&generation, recovering)?;
        let original = if recovering {
            PreparedCTask::Existing(
                OriginalCTaskPlan::open_original_existing_task(
                    task,
                    &publication,
                    &identity,
                    &decision,
                    selected.selected_manifest(),
                    baseline,
                    &owners,
                    &mut files,
                    &cancelled,
                )
                .await?,
            )
        } else {
            PreparedCTask::New(
                OriginalCTaskPlan::open_original_new_task(
                    task,
                    &publication,
                    &identity,
                    &decision,
                    selected.selected_manifest(),
                    baseline,
                    &owners,
                    &receipt,
                    &mut files,
                    &cancelled,
                )
                .await?,
            )
        };
        artifact_custody.require_original()?;
        original.require_original_custody()?;
        OriginalPreparedPublicationRoute::require_current(&publication)?;
        require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
        // Recover compares these exact existing bytes without writing. Reserve
        // commits only the canonical target and verified independent selection.
        let material = OriginalMaterialWriter::commit_original_material(
            material,
            original.target_data(),
            &signed,
        )?;
        let (handoff, connection, original_end) =
            OriginalPreparedPublicationRoute::into_original_connection(publication)?;
        if original_end != end {
            return Err(refused("original publication and continuation ends differ"));
        }
        let driver = crate::OriginalCellQ24SelectedArtifactForRootV1::connect_current_until(
            selected,
            handoff,
            connection,
            post_a_remaining(end)?.min(Duration::from_millis(500)),
            end,
        )
        .await
        .map_err(refused)?;
        material.require_unchanged()?;
        require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
        let task_custody = match original {
            PreparedCTask::New(original) => {
                let OriginalNewCTask {
                    predecessor,
                    target,
                    target_data: _,
                    execution,
                    ingress,
                    custody: task_custody,
                } = original;
                let prepared =
                    crate::OriginalCellQ24RootPublicationDriverV1::prepare_original_successor(
                        driver,
                        successor,
                        predecessor,
                        target,
                        execution,
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(refused)?;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                let installed =
                    crate::OriginalQ24PreparedSuccessorV1::publish_from_original_root(prepared)
                        .await
                        .map_err(refused)?;
                artifact_custody.require_original()?;
                task_custody.require_original()?;
                material.require_unchanged()?;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                let original_ingress =
                    crate::OriginalQ24InstalledSuccessorV1::original_installed_successor_ingress(
                        &installed,
                    )?;
                let completed = crate::OriginalCircuitFeatureIngressV1::submit_until(
                    &original_ingress,
                    ingress,
                    end,
                )
                .await?;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                task_custody.require_original()?;
                artifact_custody.require_original()?;
                material.require_unchanged()?;
                // Retire only this actual completed C through its still-held
                // publication owner. Keep the mutation synchronous in this
                // joined continuation: cancelling its future cannot leave a
                // separate blocking worker writing after owner teardown.
                if installed.identity != identity {
                    return Err(refused("original installed C retirement identity differs"));
                }
                let retirement_task = installed.published_task();
                let retirement_cell = installed.cell();
                let retirement_source = installed.source();
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                crate::PublishedCircuitFeatureTaskV1::drain_completed_task(
                    &retirement_task,
                    &retirement_cell,
                    retirement_source.as_ref(),
                    &installed.identity,
                )?;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                task_custody.require_original()?;
                artifact_custody.require_original()?;
                material.require_unchanged()?;
                let original =
                    OriginalGenerationFiles::into_original_handoff(generation, completed)?;
                OriginalCellQ24LearningStageOwnersV1::install_circuit_feature_generation(
                    &owners, snapshot, original,
                )
                .await
                .map_err(refused)?;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                task_custody
            }
            PreparedCTask::Existing(original) => {
                let intent =
                    crate::OriginalCellQ24RootPublicationDriverV1::read_original_recovery_intent(
                        &driver, &receipt,
                    )
                    .await
                    .map_err(refused)?;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                let (recovery, custody, mode) = OriginalExistingCTask::into_original_recovery(
                    original,
                    intent,
                    Arc::clone(&receipt),
                )?;
                let recovered = crate::OriginalCellQ24RootPublicationDriverV1::recover_feature_from_historical_a(
                    driver, recovery,
                ).await.map_err(refused)?;
                let original_a = Arc::clone(&receipt);
                let completed = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                    post_a_remaining(end)?;
                    let completed =
                        crate::PublishedCircuitFeatureTaskV1::recover_original_completed_successor(
                            &recovered, original_a, mode,
                        )?;
                    post_a_remaining(end)?;
                    Ok::<_, AgentdError>(completed)
                })
                .await
                .map_err(|_| refused("original completed C observation uncertain"))??;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                custody.require_original()?;
                artifact_custody.require_original()?;
                material.require_unchanged()?;
                let original = OriginalGenerationFiles::into_original_historical_handoff(
                    generation, completed,
                )?;
                OriginalCellQ24LearningStageOwnersV1::install_historical_circuit_feature_generation(
                    &owners, snapshot, original,
                ).await.map_err(refused)?;
                require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?;
                custody
            }
        };
        // Retain actual custody until the supervised daemon shuts down. The
        // learner completes Selection/NextUse through its existing owner lane.
        cancelled.cancelled().await;
        drop((
            material,
            task_custody,
            artifact_custody,
            source,
            trust,
            receipt,
            files,
        ));
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn require_continuation(
    state: &AgentdState,
    identity: &AgentdIdentity,
    cancelled: &CancellationToken,
    end: Instant,
) -> Result<(), AgentdError> {
    post_a_remaining(end)?;
    if cancelled.is_cancelled() {
        return Err(refused("original post-A continuation cancelled"));
    }
    require_successor_admission(state, identity).map_err(refused)?;
    post_a_remaining(end)?;
    Ok(())
}

    def test_completed_active_owner_and_same_source_bracket_original_drain(self):

    def test_readonly_observer_cannot_become_an_unlisted_retirement_caller(self):

        self.assertIn(path, index)
        index[path] += """

}
"""

            PROOF._verify_boundary(ROOT, boundary, index, ignored, fields_by_receiver_type={})
        self.assertIn(path, str(raised.exception))

    def test_new_c_retirement_keeps_actual_owner_and_pre_post_custody(self):

            "&retirement_cell,",
            "retirement_source.as_ref(),",
            "&installed.identity,",
            "require_continuation(&state, &identity, &cancelled, end)?",
            "task_custody.require_original()?",
            "artifact_custody.require_original()?",
            "material.require_unchanged()?",
            "OriginalGenerationFiles::into_original_handoff(",
        )
        for marker in markers:
            position = source.index(marker, offset, existing)
